description: First 1,000 decimal digits of pi (after the decimal point), including the integer part '3' and decimal point.
source: Independent decimal/Machin computation cross-checked against published reference
source_details: Computed independently using Python decimal module with Machin-like formula: pi/4 = 4*atan(1/5) - atan(1/239)
Cross-checked against the first 1,000 digits published at https://www.piday.org/million/
Algorithmically and technologically independent of the Chudnovsky/binary-splitting computation engine
verification_method: Digit-by-digit comparison against independent decimal/Machin computation; SHA-256 fingerprint recorded for integrity
usage: Committed reference fixture used by CI to verify the computation engine produces correct output. CI verifies this file's SHA-256 before use and fails if it does not match.
notes: This fixture covers only the first 1,000 digits. It is sufficient for prefix verification and CI smoke tests, but not for full verification of larger digit counts.
